title: What Should the Partner Do in the Last Weeks Before a Home Birth?
card: If she's 36 weeks along and you're just getting started, this is where to put your time: the house, the on-call plan, Plan B, your phone, and her rest.
llms: What the partner does in the last weeks before a home birth: set up the birth space and test the water heater, learn who's on call and how to reach them, know Plan B, stay reachable and close to home, take over the house so she can rest, and handle family updates, with midwife, doula and survey words.
